headline: Adani Enterprises Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about completion of acquisition of 100% stake in Vizag Mega Data Center Park Limited by AdaniConneX Private Limited ( ACX ), a joint venture of the Company.
